note: Reel 33: You Didn't Make It (working title). One voice, af_heart, at 1.0. Draft 3: after two cold reads, a care read and a fact check. Facts: docs/research.md.
ref_text: The night was cold and very quiet. Most of the street was asleep, and the lamps hummed over the empty road. Somewhere far away, a train rolled past, and then the silence came back.

lines.text: Your brother is drowning, and he's looking straight at you.
He can't even shout.
You can swim, and he can't. Do you jump in, or call for help?
If you called, help was minutes away, and he had about one.
You go home without him.
So you jump.
You've got him.
And then he climbs you.
He'd climb anything that floats, and right now, that's you.
He doesn't even know it's you.
You fight him all the way to the wall, and you push him up.
And there's nobody left to push you.
He turns round to look for you.
He made it.
You didn't.
There was a third button.
I just didn't put a number on it.
If you jumped, you dropped it. If you called, it was in your other hand.
It's an empty bottle, and nobody ever told you.
He'll climb anything that floats, so give him anything but you.
It might not be enough, but now he's got minutes, and you've got your phone.
And he's breathing, and now he knows it's you.
You know who'd jump in for you.
Nobody told them either.
So tell them.
